name: apply POSIX ACLs (live and default) to a directory so children inherit intended access
definition: apply POSIX ACLs (live and default) to a directory so children inherit intended access
failure_mode: lack of default ACLs disables inheritance and cross-user read/write fails

name: archive a directory as a compressed tar while preserving its top-level path structure
definition: Create a compressed archive whose entries keep the original leading directory component so contents can be restored at the same relative location.
failure_mode: Archiving from inside the data directory drops the leading component, so the file is not found after extraction.
